name: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Ltd
about: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited (MDL), Mumbai, established in 1774, is a prominent shipyard in India. Initially a small dry dock, MDL has evolved into a renowned shipbuilding company. It has constructed 801 vessels since 1960, including warships, submarines, cargo/passenger ships, and offshore platforms. [1]
key_points: Business Segments a) Shipbuilding: [1] [2] The company undertakes the construction and repair of naval vessels, including destroyers, stealth frigates, corvettes, patrol vessels, and commercial ships for the Indian Navy, Indian Coast Guard, and commercial customers. In Mar 2026, it signed a contract with the Shipping Corporation of India for a 3,000 DWT Methanol Dual-Fuel-Diesel-Electric Platform Supply Vessel, signalling its re-entry into commercial shipbuilding. b) Submarine and Heavy Engineering: [3] [4] The segment covers construction, repair, and refit of diesel-electric submarines, Air-Independent Propulsion (AIP) integration, and offshore heavy engineering for clients such as ONGC.

profile.summary: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited engages in the building and repairing of ships, submarines, vessels, and related engineering products in India and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Shipbuilding, and Submarine and Heavy Engineering. The company offers cargo ships, passenger ships, supply vessels, multipurpose support vessels, water tankers, tugs, dredgers, fishing trawlers, barges, and border outposts. It also provides services, including repairs and refit, designing of ships, know how provider, training, tug support, supply chain management, and self-propeller modular transporter. In addition, it offers offshore patrol vessels, fast patrol vessels, and floating boarder outposts. Further, the company provides AI products, including remotely operated vehicles, AI-enabled phased array ultrasonic testing, and AI-enabled computerized radiography. The company was formerly known as Mazagon Dock Limited and changed its name to Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited in May 2015. Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited was founded in 1774 and is based in Mumbai, India.
